Collectible Rock and Mineral Specimen Lot
7 Pieces Including Polished Stone Egg and Rough Slabs
Natural Stone and Mineral Specimens
This diverse lapidary and mineral specimen lot features seven natural stone pieces suitable for display, study, or crafting. The grouping includes a polished red and orange marbled stone egg alongside an assortment of rough, raw, and slab specimens showcasing varied mineral textures and formations.
Items Included:
One polished stone egg with red and orange marbling, measuring approximately 2 inches long
Two red and earthy jasper or petrified wood slab sections with natural weathered rinds
One druzy mineral plate featuring fine sparkling microcrystalline surface coverage
Two grey semi-translucent chalcedony and flint fragments with conchoidal fractures
One tan and brown banded stone specimen block
Condition:
All items are in pre-owned condition. The polished egg displays a smooth glossy surface with natural internal fissure lines. The rough rock and slab specimens exhibit natural rough textures, raw fracture edges, surface inclusions, and earth matrix consistent with unpolished geological specimens.
Thank you for all of your support!

You are purchasing a "Mixed Rock and Gemstone Collection Lot with Carvings" in "Used" condition.
Large mixed lot of rocks, minerals, gemstones, and unique stone pieces – perfect for collectors, classrooms, crafts, or decor. This collection includes a wide variety of natural and polished pieces, all together in one ready-to-use bundle. You’ll get: - Multiple rough pink stones and clear quartz-like points - Amethyst crystal cluster with geode-style formation - Bagged mix of small blue and purple gemstone chips - Assorted tumbled gemstones in various colors (blue, red, orange, green, brown, and more) - Several rough and smooth natural rocks in different shapes and patterns - Fossil-like and porous stones with interesting textures - Large striped flat stone slab and other patterned stones - Stone desk base with two gold-tone pen holders - Carved stone figures including a polished bear, a polished sphere, and a tooth-shaped carving - Mixed small rock and gemstone lot with a gemstones & fossils reference card This is a fun, visually striking assortment with plenty of variety for display, study, or creative projects. The amethyst cluster and geode-style piece have natural crystal terminations and some rough edges. The fossil-like and porous stones show natural pitting and texture. The stone desk stand with two gold-tone pen holders has a few small surface marks and light wear to the metal finish.
